dialogue.content: おはようございます。相談員です。まず初めによろしかったら年齢、性別、相談内容についてお聞かせ下さい。
dialogue.English: Good morning. I’m the counselor. To begin, if you're comfortable, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you’d like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 29歳　女です。恋愛のことで悩んでて、、、
dialogue.English: I'm 29 and female. I'm having some trouble with my love life...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、お悩みなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you're feeling troubled about that.

dialogue.content: 具体的には恋愛のどのようことでお悩みなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more specifically about your relationship concerns?

dialogue.content: 今彼氏がいるんですけど、ずっと忘れられない人がいるんです
dialogue.English: I have a boyfriend right now, but there's someone I can't get out of my mind.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: わすれたいんですけど
dialogue.English: I want to forget, but...

dialogue.content: ずっと消えなくて
dialogue.English: he's always on my mind.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 彼氏がいるのに
dialogue.English: Even though I have a boyfriend...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なんか申し訳ないというかしんどいというか
dialogue.English: I feel guilty... and it's just hard.

dialogue.content: どうやったら思い出さなくなるかなって
dialogue.English: I keep wondering how I can stop thinking about him.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ずっと忘れられないのもお辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: It must be painful to not be able to forget him for so long.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 今の彼氏にも悪いなと思われていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: You feel bad for your current boyfriend as well, don't you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それもしんどいですよね。
dialogue.English: That must be tough, too.

dialogue.content: 今の彼氏が一番なんですけど、なんでこんなにも思い出してしまうんかなーって
dialogue.English: My current boyfriend is the most important person to me, but I just don't understand why I keep thinking about this other person.

dialogue.content: いやなんです
dialogue.English: I hate it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、そのことでご自分を責められてしまうんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, you're blaming yourself for that, aren't you?

dialogue.content: 責めるというかなんというか
dialogue.English: I don't know if 'blame' is the right word, but...

dialogue.content: なんなんだろうって
dialogue.English: More like, what’s going on with me?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、ご自分でもなんなんだろうなと納得されていらっしゃらないのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you yourself can't quite make sense of why you're feeling this way.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: なるほど。忘れられない彼氏の方とは、いつ頃のことでいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. When was your relationship with the person you can’t forget?

dialogue.content: 4年前くらいです職場の上司なので、嫌でも今も見かけるんです
dialogue.English: About four years ago. He’s my supervisor at work, so I still see him, whether I like it or not.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。そのような状況では、しんどいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be a very difficult situation.

dialogue.content: ほんと、そうですよね
dialogue.English: It really is.

dialogue.content: 長い間忘れられないと教えていただきましたが、どのような忘れられない思いがおありなんでしょうか？教えていただける範囲で結構ですが。
dialogue.English: You mentioned that you haven't been able to forget him for a long time. If you're comfortable sharing, could you tell me what it is about him that's so unforgettable?

dialogue.content: 忘れられない人は職場での指導係的な人で入ったときから色々助けてくれてた人なんです。付き合うようになったんですけど、職場の人には秘密にしてて、しばらくしたら違う人と付き合ってるって話を周りががしてて
dialogue.English: The person I can't forget was a sort of mentor at my job; he helped me a lot from the time I started. We began dating, but we kept it a secret from our coworkers. Then, after a while, I heard people around the office saying he was dating someone else.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 私にはなんの話もなく、しばらくしたら結婚したんですよね
dialogue.English: He never said a word to me about it, and then a short time later, he got married.

dialogue.content: 何にも話してくれず、話そうという場をもうけようにも無理でなかったことにされたみたいな
dialogue.English: He didn't explain anything, and it was impossible to even arrange a time to talk. It felt like he just acted like our relationship never happened.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。それはショックでいらしたですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been a huge shock for you.

dialogue.content: でも、何事もなかったように飲みに行こうとか誘ってくるんです、意味わかんないなって
dialogue.English: But he still asks me out for drinks as if nothing ever happened. I just can't make sense of it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか？
dialogue.English: He does?

dialogue.content: ショックもそうですし、何が起こったかわかんないかんじでした
dialogue.English: I was shocked, and I also just couldn't understand what was happening.

dialogue.content: 相手にとっては今までのことはなかったことになってて、過ごしてるのかなって
dialogue.English: I feel like for him, it's as if our past never existed, and he's just moved on.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、そういう状況では理解出来ないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's completely understandable that you can't make sense of a situation like that.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 貴方にとっては、入社間もなく色々教えてくれたので、優しい方というイメージがおありなのでしょうね。
dialogue.English: For you, since he taught you so much right after you joined the company, you must have seen him as a very kind person.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね、仕事にかんしてもプライベートにかんしても相談したりしてて尊敬してた人だったんですよね
dialogue.English: That's right. I used to talk to him about both work and my personal life. He was someone I really respected.

dialogue.content: だからこそ、ショックが大きいと言うか
dialogue.English: That's why the shock was so much greater.

dialogue.content: こんな人だと思ってなかったって感じです
dialogue.English: I just didn’t think he was that kind of person.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。貴方にとっ　はい
dialogue.English: I see. For you... Yes.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、貴方にとっては頼りがいのある方だったのですね。それは、余計ショックですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So for you, he was someone you could rely on. That must make the shock even greater.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it does.

dialogue.content: ショックが大きすぎて忘れられないのかなっても思うんですけど
dialogue.English: I sometimes wonder if I can't forget him because the shock was so great.

dialogue.content: 自分がショックをうけたこととか怒りとかを本人にぶつければすっきりするかなとか
dialogue.English: I wonder if I would feel better if I could just confront him with my feelings of shock and anger.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そう思わるのは、無理もないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's completely understandable that you would feel that way.

dialogue.content: 考えたりもしたんですけど
dialogue.English: I’ve thought about it, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 結婚した人も同じ職場でみんな祝福してるから周りにもなんもいえなくて
dialogue.English: The person he married also works with us, and everyone was congratulating them, so I couldn't say anything to anyone around me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 怒りぶつけてもむなしいだけかなとか
dialogue.English: I feel like even if I did confront him, it would just be pointless.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それもやりきれないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be an incredibly frustrating feeling.

dialogue.content: 色々かんがえたんですけど、結局なにもせずにすごしてきたんですよね
dialogue.English: I've thought about it a lot, but in the end, I've just let the time pass without doing anything.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。そういう状況で貴方はひとりで悩みを抱えられて過ごされてきたんですね。それはお辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been dealing with this all by yourself in that situation. That must have been so difficult for you.

dialogue.content: ほんとによくやってきたなーって自分でほめてました
dialogue.English: I've actually been praising myself for getting through it all.

dialogue.content: でもいまは
dialogue.English: But now...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼がいるので
dialogue.English: I have my boyfriend...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 幸せだなって思うんです
dialogue.English: And I feel happy.

dialogue.content: そうですか、それはよかったですね。
dialogue.English: I see, that's wonderful to hear.

dialogue.content: それなのに職場で見かける度にもやもやしてしまうんです
dialogue.English: And yet, every time I see him at work, I get this feeling of frustration.

dialogue.content: なるほど。色々お話し伺って、貴方は前の彼氏のことを引きずられてもやもやされていらっしゃる。
dialogue.English: I see. From what you've told me, you're still feeling unsettled because you're hung up on your ex-boyfriend.

dialogue.content: 今後は、どんな風になったらいいなと思われますか？
dialogue.English: Going forward, how would you like things to be?

dialogue.content: 昔のことを思い出さずに過ごしたいんです
dialogue.English: I want to live my life without thinking about the past.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そうするにはどんな方法が考えらますかね？
dialogue.English: I see. What kinds of ways do you think might help you do that?

dialogue.content: んー、この数年考えてきましたけど、わからなくて、時間が解決してくれるのかなって思ってました
dialogue.English: Hmm, I've been thinking about it for the last few years, but I don't know. I was hoping time would solve everything.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。一緒に考えていきたいと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I see. I would like to think about this together with you, if that's okay?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: それでは、今一番大切な彼氏は、どんな方でいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: Alright then, what kind of person is your current boyfriend, the one who is most important to you right now?

dialogue.content: 優しくて、考えを理解してくれる、周りの人への気遣いができるひとです
dialogue.English: He's kind, he understands how I feel, and he's considerate of the people around him.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。とても素敵な方なんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. He sounds like a wonderful person.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, he is.

dialogue.content: 貴方にとって、前の彼氏と、今の彼氏、どちらの方が、幸せに導いてくれると思われますか？
dialogue.English: For you, between your ex-boyfriend and your current boyfriend, who do you think can lead you to happiness?

dialogue.content: もちろん、それは今の彼氏です
dialogue.English: Of course, it's my current boyfriend.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。男性として、前の彼氏のように、結婚されていて、前の彼女に何事もなかったように誘ってくるひとをどう思われますか？
dialogue.English: Right. As a man, what do you think of someone like your ex-boyfriend, who is married yet asks his ex-girlfriend out as if nothing ever happened?

dialogue.content: くずだなって思ってます
dialogue.English: I think he’s a jerk.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。そう思われるのは当然ですよね。
dialogue.English: Right. It's completely natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まず、今の彼氏の方を大切にされる。
dialogue.English: First, focus on cherishing your current boyfriend.

dialogue.content: 前の彼氏が、誘ってきたらきっぱり断りの話をされるのは、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: And if your ex-boyfriend asks you out, how about firmly turning him down?

dialogue.content: なんて言えばいいですかね何回か誘われて用事があるからで断ってるんですけど
dialogue.English: What should I say? He's asked me out a few times, and I've just told him I was busy.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。私には彼氏がいて、そのひとのことを大切に思っていることを伝えてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. How about telling him that you have a boyfriend and that you cherish that relationship?

dialogue.content: あー、なるほど
dialogue.English: Ah, I see.

dialogue.content: 是非トライしてみてください。お話しされて、今どのようなお気持ちですか？
dialogue.English: Please give it a try. Now that we've had this conversation, how are you feeling?

dialogue.content: やれたらやってみます
dialogue.English: I’ll try if I can.

dialogue.content: 話をできただけでも少しすっきりしたかもしれないです
dialogue.English: I think I feel a little better just from being able to talk about it.

dialogue.content: ちゃんと今の人に向き合おうと思います
dialogue.English: I'm going to try to properly focus on my current relationship.

dialogue.content: それは良かったです。それが一番だと思います。応援しています。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. I think that's the best approach. I'll be supporting you.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今日はこちらにお起こしいただきありがとうございます。是非続きを聞かせて下さい。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today. I would love to hear how things go.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。大変勉強になりました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. This has been a great learning experience.)
